_meta.copiedVsOurs: Copied: Tracery syntax only. Borrowed ideas: Story Spine order, Polti deadline+adversary, rule of three, callback. All text is original.
_meta.objectWin: Each object carries a 'win' line so the move resolves its own trigger (rulebook §4 'no unpaid setups').

objectVillain: [v:the toaster][room:Kitchen][quirk:burns the left side of every slice, and only the left side][trigger:You drop in two slices for a quick snack.][grudge:It fires both slices at the ceiling, like a warning shot.][win:The next slice pops up golden on both sides.][vLine:It's doing it on purpose. Look at it.]

[v:the kettle][room:Kitchen][quirk:clicks off exactly one degree before the water boils][trigger:You need one cup of hot water, just one.][grudge:It clicks off four times in a row, like it's counting your mistakes.][win:The water finally boils, with a sulky little hiss.][vLine:It's mocking you. That click was sarcastic.]

[v:the washing machine][room:Laundry room][quirk:eats exactly one sock per load, never two][trigger:You need your only matching pair of socks, fast.][grudge:It has kept every sock it ever took, and it will never say where.][win:It spits out both socks, damp but matching.][vLine:I think it's building something in there.]

[v:the Wi-Fi router][room:#routerRoom#][quirk:drops the internet whenever someone says "one more episode"][trigger:You need it to play some calm background music.][grudge:Its little light turns red and stays red, like an evil eye.][win:The music starts, soft and calm.][vLine:Don't say the word 'episode.' It's listening.]
guestBundle: [guest:your aunt][deadline:Your aunt is coming over for tea in twenty minutes.][guestPayoff:Your aunt arrives, sips her tea, and calls the place "very lived in."]
[guest:your landlord][deadline:Your landlord arrives for an inspection in fifteen minutes.][guestPayoff:Your landlord arrives and ticks every box on his clipboard.]
[guest:your new neighbour][deadline:Your new neighbour is coming by in ten minutes to borrow a ladder.][guestPayoff:Your new neighbour arrives, takes the ladder, and says the place smells nice.]
panicLine: Please tell me you have a plan.
Should I hide? I feel like I should hide.
next: Next: a fitted sheet, and it refuses to be folded.

punchline:
#guestPayoff#
#v.cap# stays silent the whole visit.
It is clearly saving its energy for you.

#guestPayoff#
Nobody mentions #v# once.
#v.cap# has noticed that nobody mentions it.

#guestPayoff#
#v.cap# behaves perfectly until the front door closes.
Then it does its thing again, just for you.

#guestPayoff#
On the way out, #guest# compliments #v#.
#v.cap# has never looked so smug.
reveal__cat_structure__high: Your systems aren't fussy. They're armour.
reveal__cat_structure__low: No system, yet somehow everything works. That's your system.
reveal__cat_resilience__high: You don't win first. You win last.
reveal__cat_resilience__low: You pick your battles, yet you never lose the war.
